build: release + mimalloc; stock Flink 2.2.1 on JDK17
boundary: Released Rank operator in Java on prepared BinaryRowData vs production append TopN inside Rust on prepared Arrow List-of-entry-struct buffers. Setup/import/export/JNI/perimeter transposes excluded; keying/state/output construction/full map key-value consumption included. Rust native budget 1 GiB, batch 1024, bound3.
oracle: Every source payload and partition checked by emitted id. Independent full id x RowKind x rank histogram from released Flink, then count and full-value checksums for all trials. Map NULL parents, empties, NULL keys and nullable values; multiset positive counts.
comparison_limits: Before is the unchanged preceding native rank kernel on the prepared physical inputs, before the payload rejection optimization. The prior SQL planner rejects MAP retained rows; 35 actual fallback controls are independently pinned. This is not a previous complete-job comparison. High-churn ranges overlap; no universal speedup or join/first-N throughput claim.

profile.boundary: Native executable including one untimed full-oracle pass, input import and 22 timed rank passes. perf has no DWARF unwinding on this host; leaf addresses symbolized with addr2line.

validation.root_map_udf: 3 explicit correct-fallback cases; not newly admitted
validation.unverified_keys: MAP/MULTISET descendants in partition/join/order/update-fast unique keys still fall back.
validation.scope: Insert-only MAP-bearing retained inputs. Updating map-bearing Top-N/LIMIT/join inputs pin correctness fallback; issue437, no performance opt-in bypass.

pre_submission_edge_tests.native_qualification: Reordered collision-key maps fail projected retracting Top-N on heap/RocksDB, both releases; raw row counts can still agree. The same reordered input also fails updating-join final multiplicities.
pre_submission_edge_tests.stock_control: Both reordered Top-N stock controls pass. Initial OFFSET stock-control assertions were incorrectly expecting fallback while only the topN switch was disabled; LIMIT remained native. This was a route-expectation error, not a stock wrong-result claim.
pre_submission_edge_tests.accepted_admission: Insert-only carrier support remains enabled. All updating MAP-bearing retained input remains stock until retained-row semantics are implemented.
pre_submission_edge_tests.updating_join_counts: Reordered-key native join emitted 128 records versus stock80 in both backend/release controls before the guard.

flink_1.18.1.skips: Ordinary non-time ROW_NUMBER is unavailable on this released host.

validation.oracle_notes: Ranking compares complete raw row/RowKind multisets; independently interleaved updating joins compare final multiplicities and types. The first guarded-join fixture incorrectly required identical raw intermediate rows across restores; final runs use the same materialization rule as outer joins.

existing_controls.coverage: Six existing stateful MAP payload/key checks now require native carriage for append-only payloads and fallback for MAP keys; fifteen nested SQL/JSON controls retain their previous admission.

nested_map_udf_composition.scope: ROW-returning scalar UDF with a string-to-string MAP child, ordinary scalar ordering native vs computed collection ordering existing fallback, heap/RocksDB and two restores. No additional UDF overload admission.

measurement_order: Initial stock/before/initial-candidate serial matrix; final combined-driver Rust timings on the same frozen fixtures after correctness qualification, idle host. Stock controls retained from initial matrix; engine drift is not isolated by the later combined pass.
